newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikko, Smith Barney venture to be equally-owned.
newsitem.headline: Nikko, Smith Barney venture to be equally-owned.

text.p: Nikko Securities Co Ltd said on Friday that its planned joint venture with Smith Barney International Inc will be equally-owned by the two companies.
Further details of the joint venture, such as capitalisation and management, will be hammered out by late October, Nikko said in a statement.
Nikko said earlier on Friday that it and the U.S. brokerage have agreed to set up a joint venture, through which they plan to offer wrap account services in the future.
The statement said the joint venture will initially offer software and systems for making customised asset allocation models for investment trust funds.
